terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.updated: Last updated: July 27, 2026 — Official operational terms for Puncak Drive car rental service.
terms.sec1Text: All Puncak Drive vehicle fleets operating in Puncak, Bogor, Cianjur, and surrounding areas must be accompanied by an official professional Driver from Puncak Drive. This policy guarantees safety and comfort on steep, traffic-prone mountain routes. Self-drive rentals are strictly limited to corporate partners with full verification.
terms.sec2Text: Renters must provide valid official identification (ID Card / Passport & KITAS) along with pickup address details and an active WhatsApp emergency contact number.
terms.sec3Text: Reservations are valid once official confirmation is received from Puncak Drive WhatsApp Admin. Payment can be made via official bank transfer or cash per official invoice.
terms.sec4Text: Cancellations made at least 24 hours prior to pickup time (D-1) incur no fee. Same-day cancellations may incur a 50% administrative fee.
terms.sec5Text: All our vehicles are insured and regularly undergo routine roadworthiness inspections. Puncak Drive is responsible for fleet maintenance and driver performance during rental periods.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: July 27, 2026 — Customer data confidentiality and protection guarantee document.
privacy.sec1Text: Puncak Drive collects personal data such as Full Name, WhatsApp Contact Number, Email Address, Reservation Date, and Pickup Location solely for rental processing, driver coordination, and invoice generation.
privacy.sec2Text: We apply digital encryption security standards to protect your data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. Your information is stored on secure closed servers accessible only by authorized personnel.
privacy.sec3Text: Puncak Drive guarantees never selling, renting, sharing, or trading customer personal data to any third party for commercial marketing. Data is shared exclusively with assigned Drivers for pickup coordination.
privacy.sec4Text: Customers have the right to request updates, corrections, or deletion of all personal data from our systems after rental periods complete by contacting Customer Support.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.updated: Last updated: July 27, 2026 — Information on cookie usage and local storage on Puncak Drive website.
cookies.sec1Text: Cookies are small text files stored on your browser when visiting the Puncak Drive website. Cookies help remember preference settings so future visits are faster and more efficient.
cookies.sec2Text: Puncak Drive uses essential functional cookies exclusively to store user language preference choices (i18n: Indonesian, English, Arabic) and maintain fleet filter selections across pages.
cookies.sec3Text: You have the right to decline or delete browser cookies at any time via your browser settings menu. Note that disabling essential cookies may affect automatic language memory.
